Where inflation is coming from: 150 regencies and cities by expenditure group and sub-group. Colours show distance from the centre point: 2.5% for year-on-year (the midpoint of BI's 2.5 ± 1% target) and 0% for month-on-month.

Source: BPS WebAPI, 150 Kab/Kota CPI tables (2022=100), month-on-month and year-on-year inflation by expenditure group and sub-group. Headline month-on-month is computed from the city CPI index. Cities are tagged to provinces and island regions using BPS table order. BPS does not publish city weights here, so dispersion and breadth count every city equally.
